label: triggers immediate execution of
type: the subject REST operation runs the named scheduled task type immediately, bypassing its normal schedule - 'run now'. Distinct from scheduledBy (which names what determines a task's normal recurring schedule) and from createsOnAction (which is about creating a new persistent object, not re-running an existing one).
evidence: Triggers an immediate backup for the specified active repository: thus, the need to wait for a scheduled backup can be eliminated as required.
Triggers an immediate merge for the specified active repository: thus, the need to wait for a scheduled backup can be eliminated as required.
Triggers an immediate pruning of backups for the specified active repository. As a result, the need to wait for a scheduled pruning can be skipped when required.
note: Minted and reused across all three of the Backup Service's 'perform an immediate X' REST endpoints (backup-trigger-backup.md, backup-trigger-merge.md, backup-trigger-prune.md) with near-identical wording each time - a clean case of one predicate covering one well-evidenced mechanism (run-now vs scheduled) across all three task types in the BACKUP/MERGE/PRUNE family.
